subject: general
question: Kanishka, belonged to the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kushan Dynasty.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kanishka belonged to the Kushan dynasty.**
 
• The kushan dynasty was **founded by Kujūla Kadphises.**
 
• Kanishka ruled around the 1st century CE and was the greatest king of the Kushan dynasty.
 
• At the time of Kanishka, kushan rule was spread over the northern part of the Indian subcontinent, Afghanistan, and possibly areas of Central Asia north of the Kashmir region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• He is also remembered as a **great patron of Buddhism.**
 
• **He studied Buddhism under the Buddhist poet Ashvaghosha.**
 
• The Fourth Buddhist Council was also convened under his patronage in Kashmir.
 
• That council compiled The Great Commentary on Abhidharma.
